card.name: Just before a colon in ratios
card.fires_on: The word or number right before a colon in ratios, time formats and labelled lists, such as the 1 in 1:100,000 or Hours in Hours:Minutes:Seconds.

modes.label: Ratio numbers
modes.description: A digit that opens a ratio, such as a dilution or mix ratio, just before the colon.

modes.label: Time or field lists
modes.description: A unit name or label inside a colon-separated format list.

card.writes: It promotes colon tokens, so the model expects a colon next.
card.plain: It fires on a number or label that is about to be followed by a colon, as in a ratio like 1:200,000 or a time format.
